newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: ANGOLA, Feb 10 - Port congestion in Luanda. Quay congested, clearance takes considerable time. Lack of space on quays slowing discharge, all berths occupied. Four vessels awaiting general berths. Delays 2-5 days depending on vessel/cargo. Lobito, Namibe no delays. Cabinda no delays.
SYRIA, Feb 1 - waiting time at Lattakia/Tartous 24 hours.

PORTUGAL, Feb 11 - At least three vessels prevented from entering Lisbon due to pilots' strike following detention of nine pilots on corruption charges. source in the navigation agents association said if the strike persisted the government may authorise ships regularly using Lisbon to do without pilot.
